title: Shinkolobwe Uranium Mine
note: Katangan pitchblende mine in the Belgian Congo that provided two-thirds of the Manhattan Project's uranium; central African hub of colonial resource extraction and early nuclear history.

title: Trinity Nuclear Test
note: First detonation of a nuclear weapon in New Mexico's Jornada del Muerto desert, initiating the atomic age and creating widespread radioactive fallout affecting Tularosa Basin downwinders.

title: Lise Meitner
note: Austrian-Swedish nuclear physicist who led the group that discovered nuclear fission in 1938 and provided the first theoretical explanation, refusing invitations to join the Manhattan Project.

title: Tularosa Basin Downwinders Consortium
note: Grassroots organization advocating health compensation, official recognition, and environmental justice for New Mexico civilian communities exposed to 1945 Trinity fallout.
